cards.answer: Garen is a fighter and tank who damages nearby enemies with sword spins. He uses a speed boost and a silencing attack to pressure foes, then threatens weakened champions with a finishing blow.
cards.counterplay: Keep space from his spin and empowered attack. Retreat before your health becomes critically low near him.

cards.answer: Perseverance regenerates a portion of Garen's maximum health while active. Champion, epic monster or turret damage, enemy ability hits, and enemy summoner spells can temporarily interrupt it.
cards.counterplay: Use safe opportunities to pressure him so he cannot freely recover health between fights.

citations.quote: Perseverance is lost for 8 seconds if Garen takes damage from champions, epic monsters, or turrets, or if he is hit by an enemy ability or affected by an enemy summoner spell, refreshing on subsequent damage and hits taken from them.

facts.claim: Champion, epic monster or turret damage, enemy ability hits, and enemy summoner spells can temporarily interrupt it.

cards.priority_reason: His recovery affects how much lasting progress a short trade makes.

Subsequent qualifying events refresh the interruption; not every damage source interrupts regeneration.

cards.answer: Decisive Strike grants movement speed and removes existing slows. Garen's next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and silences its target.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance when he speeds toward you. Do not rely on an existing slow to stop his approach.

citations.quote: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him.
Active: Garen gains bonus movement speed and cleanses from slows.

facts.claim: Decisive Strike grants movement speed and removes existing slows.

His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

facts.claim: Garen's next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and silences its target.

cards.priority_reason: The movement speed and silence create a consequential approach threat.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Removing existing slows does not prevent their reapplication.
The empowered attack has a limited availability window and resets the basic attack timer.
Spell shields negate only the silence. Attack completion, terrain interactions and on-hit details are omitted advanced exceptions.

cards.answer: Killing eligible enemies permanently builds Garen's armor and magic resistance, up to a cap. Activating Courage briefly grants a shield and increased tenacity. It also reduces incoming damage, lasting beyond the brief shield and tenacity.
cards.counterplay: Avoid committing your main burst of damage into his defensive activation.

cards.answer: Judgment repeatedly deals physical damage to nearby enemies as Garen spins, with increased damage to the nearest enemy hit. Bonus attack speed from items and level growth increases his number of spins. Repeated spin hits reduce enemy champions' armor.
cards.counterplay: Move out of his spin to limit repeated hits and armor reduction. Avoid being the nearest enemy hit when possible.

cards.answer: Demacian Justice targets an enemy champion with a true-damage finishing blow. Its damage increases with the target's missing health.
cards.counterplay: Retreat before your health becomes critically low near Garen. A shield or spell shield can help protect against his finishing attempt.
